g.text: GROUND PLATE - 25.4 MM (1 IN) BELOW TRACK
RAISED TRACK BED - FRONT EDGE THIS SIDE
Double 618 x 330 - RAISED TRACK BED TO THE FRONT EDGE, 25.4 mm (1 in) DROP
Purple... Adjust Kerf OUT Green... Adjust Kerf IN Red... Engrave or Delete, do not cut.
Raised bed runs from the front edge back to y 110; ground plate 25.4 mm (1 in) lower behind it.
